item.title: The Almanac 0.5.2
item.description:
• The food, water and medicine collections are now searchable. Answers cite the book and the pages, "Medical Library · Where There Is No Doctor · pages 4–6", and clicking one opens the book's text at that passage.
  • These collections hold PDFs only, so the first time you open the app after updating, it reads them once in the background (about 18 MB of space, and well under a minute on a recent Mac). Each collection is searchable as soon as its first PDF is read, and Settings › Library shows each collection's progress ("Reading PDFs · 5 of 12") until it's done, then how many PDFs it holds. A scanned PDF with no text is counted ("17 PDFs · 1 has no text (scanned)"), not hidden. If the disk is nearly full, a PDF waits until there is room.
  • Health answers drawn from the medical PDFs show the book's words, like every other health answer.
